name: Setup Wizard stick center reads the FC and writes rc_center only when the sticks agree
step: Check the Receiver step's stick center card
rationale:
Radios don't all send 1500 us with the sticks centered: some ELRS setups send 1520, and the FC
then reads every stick as slightly off center. The Receiver step's stick center card reads the FC's
channels (MSP_RX_CHANNELS, not the radio's own outputs: the offset is in what reaches the FC),
averages roll, pitch and yaw, and writes rc_center.

The harness runs the real page and lib/setup_wizard_heli.lua with the screen, bus and wizard
stubbed, and pins: the hint from one read when the card opens, an off trim named with nothing
written, rc_center written with the rest of the RC config kept and registered for Discard, and
the stick center listed on Done.

--self-test makes centreIsOff() always false and requires the write checks to go red.
